title: Sign-up email link arrives and signs you in
instructions: On https://sanctum-web-xi.vercel.app/auth/signup, sign up with a real inbox you control (e.g. you+sanctum@gmail.com). The email should arrive within a minute and clicking it should land on the disclaimer or onboarding. Afterwards remove the test account from Sanctum's admin page.

title: Upgrading through Stripe checkout unlocks the plan
instructions: With a test account, go to Account → Manage plan and upgrade to Plus (Stripe test mode, card 4242 4242 4242 4242). After returning, the plan shows Plus and the Plus features open. Cancel the subscription afterwards.

title: Daily check-in reminder email arrives
instructions: With a test account, turn on the daily reminder in Account → Notifications for a time a few minutes ahead. The reminder email should arrive at that time and its link should open the check-in screen.

title: Tessa gives a sensible real reply
instructions: The automated tests simulate Tessa (no real AI calls). Occasionally, with a Premium/test account, send Tessa an ordinary message and confirm the reply is sensible and on-brand.
